issues.title: Internal class missing sealed keyword
issues.description: Internal implementation classes that are not designed for inheritance must be marked with the 'sealed' keyword. The WebSocketWrapper class is an internal implementation class that should be sealed to prevent unintended subclassing.
issues.rule_name: Sealed Keyword Required for Internal Implementation Classes

issues.title: Incorrect boolean operator in regex validation
issues.description: The test assertion uses AND (&&) operator instead of OR (||) when checking if the log message matches either the old or new CSP error pattern. This causes the test to fail because a log message cannot simultaneously match both regex patterns - they represent different browser error message formats. The original intent was to accept either format, but the AND operator requires both patterns to match at the same time, which is impossible. This will cause the test to fail even when receiving a valid CSP error message in either format.
issues.problematic_code_snippet:
Assert.True(
    ParseErrorMessageRegexOld.IsMatch(logs[0].Message) &&
    ParseErrorMessageRegexNew.IsMatch(logs[0].Message),
    $"Expected log message to match one of the CSP error patterns: {ParseErrorMessageRegexOld} or {ParseErrorMessageRegexNew}. Actual: {logs[0].Message}");

issues.title: Disposal order causing potential race condition
issues.description: The connection disposal order is reversed - disposing secondConnection before the connection that is still being used. In the test, 'connection' performs an InvokeAsync call and its TaskCompletionSource (tcs) is awaited immediately before disposal. However, disposing secondConnection first may cause premature cleanup of shared resources or message handlers since both connections share the same user ('*'). This can lead to flaky test behavior where the connection's pending operations are interrupted by the disposal of secondConnection, especially in distributed scenarios where both connections interact with the same Redis backplane.

issues.title: Race condition from premature TaskCompletionSource recreation
issues.description: The _receiveTcs TaskCompletionSource is recreated before checking if the buffer is zero-sized, creating a race condition in the WebSocketWrapper's ReceiveAsync implementation. When a zero-byte read occurs (buffer.Count == 0), the method returns early with the result but the TCS has already been reset. This means if another thread or the background task tries to set a result on the now-recreated TCS while this zero-byte read is in progress, it will affect the next receive operation rather than completing the current one. This breaks the synchronization contract and can cause message loss or out-of-order receives in the stateful reconnection test scenarios where WebSocket message sequencing is critical.

pr.title: Code Review Bench PR #64685 - [release/9.0] Update dependencies from dotnet/arcade

structured_output.summary:
This PR updates dependencies from the dotnet/arcade repository, bumping versions from 9.0.0-beta.25562.4 to 9.0.0-beta.25626.6 for multiple Arcade-related packages including Microsoft.DotNet.Arcade.Sdk, Microsoft.SourceBuild.Intermediate.arcade, Microsoft.DotNet.Build.Tasks.Installers, Microsoft.DotNet.Build.Tasks.Templating, Microsoft.DotNet.Helix.Sdk, and Microsoft.DotNet.RemoteExecutor. In addition to the version updates, the PR includes several infrastructure-related changes:
1. A source build template change from 1es-mariner-2 to 1es-azurelinux-3 VM image
2. A condition change in source-index-stage1.yml to only run on the main branch
3. Updates to internal runtime download URLs from blob.core.windows.net to ci.dot.net/internal
4. Addition of -UseBasicParsing parameter to Invoke-WebRequest calls in PowerShell scripts for improved compatibility
5. Null-safety improvements in LocateVisualStudio function in tools.ps1

The PR also includes test file changes: WebSocketCompressionTests now checks for both old and new CSP error message patterns, and RedisEndToEnd.cs has test quarantining added and a minor fix to disposal order in WebSocketWrapper.
structured_output.verdictRationale: A critical issue was found in WebSocketCompressionTests.cs where the validation logic uses AND (&&) instead of OR (||) to check for CSP error message patterns. This means the test would require both old and new message formats to appear simultaneously in the log, which is impossible since they are mutually exclusive patterns. The fix is to change && to || on line 108.

architecture.overview:
The PR updates ASP.NET Core's dependency on dotnet/arcade from version 9.0.0-beta.25562.4 to 9.0.0-beta.25626.6. This affects the tooling and build infrastructure used by the repository. The key files involved are Version.Details.xml and Versions.props which define dependencies, global.json which specifies MSBuild SDK versions, and several template and script files in eng/common/ which define CI build behavior.

The dependency update is accompanied by several infrastructure improvements: a VM image refresh in source-build templates, URL changes for internal runtime downloads, PowerShell compatibility enhancements via -UseBasicParsing, and null-safety improvements in Visual Studio detection logic. Test files were updated to handle CSP error message changes and add quarantined test markers.
steps: Dependency files (eng/Version.Details.xml and eng/Versions.props) are updated with new versions and SHA commits for Arcade packages, replacing 9.0.0-beta.25562.4 with 9.0.0-beta.25626.6 across 6 dependencies.
global.json is updated to reference the new Arcade SDK versions in the msbuild-sdks section.

Source build templates (source-build.yml, source-index-stage1.yml) are modified: VM image changes from 1es-mariner-2 to 1es-azurelinux-3, and source-index-stage1 gains a condition to only run on main branch.

PowerShell scripts (internal-feed-operations.ps1, nuget-verification.ps1, tools.ps1) gain -UseBasicParsing parameter on Invoke-WebRequest calls for better compatibility, and LocateVisualStudio gains null-safety checks for vsRequirements object members.
The source-build.yml template updates the internal runtime download URL from dotnetbuilds.blob.core.windows.net to ci.dot.net/internal.

Test files WebSocketCompressionTests.cs now validates against both old and new CSP error message patterns, and RedisEndToEnd.cs adds QuarantinedTest attributes and fixes WebSocketWrapper disposal order.
